newsitem.title: USA: U.S. oil prices mixed on ACCESS after API report.
newsitem.headline: U.S. oil prices mixed on ACCESS after API report.

text.p: U.S. energy futures prices were mostly lower in moderately active after-hours trade, influenced mainly by inventory data from the American Petroleum Institute (API), industry sources said.
October NYMEX crude traded 13 cents lower than its settle price of $21.56 a barrel. One thousand sixty-nine lots traded early into ACCESS.

"I think it's all on the API," said one trader, who noted that few other trading incentives were present so far this week. API this week detailed a huge 10 million barrel rise in crude oil stocks and a 2.2 million barrels gasoline draw. Distillate stocks eased 463,000 barrels from last week.
September gasoline added 0.14 cent on ACCESS, recouping some of the 0.41 cent it lost earlier today. It traded at 61.21 cents on ACCESS, with 199 lots changing hands.
And front-month heating oil eased 0.13 cent a gallon to traded at 61 cents as 131 lots were traded.
Mildly active trade is expected to persist this week ahead of the long Labor Day Holiday weekend.
-- Franklin Paul, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1620
